name: Phage
description: Under Ixidor's Nightmare spell she regurgitated beetles that became deathwurms; Jeska chose to absorb them back.

timeline.summary: Jeska is cursed by the Cabal Patriarch and becomes the avatar Phage the Untouchable.
timeline.quote: Otarian barbarian Jeska was cursed by the Cabal Patriarch inadvertently turning her into the avatar Phage the Untouchable .

citation.text: "Avatar", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamhal's Soul Reaper slays Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, leading to the rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: leading Phage, Akroma, and Zagorka to all be slain by the attack.

citation.text: "Avatar", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Patriarch's attempt to destroy Jeska instead gives birth to Phage the Untouchable.
timeline.quote: attempt to destroy Jeska instead gave birth to Phage the Untouchable

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage builds the Grand Coliseum.
timeline.quote: She built the Grand Coliseum

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl, Phage and Akroma fight in the Grand Coliseum; Akroma loses her legs and Kamahl wins.
timeline.quote: After a three-way bout with Kamahl and Akroma in the Grand Coliseum

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor's dream magic sends the deathwurms out of Phage, leaving her Jeska again.
timeline.quote: those deathwurms were sent out into the world, leaving her once again Jeska

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: To save the land Jeska pulls the deathwurms back into herself, damning herself to life as Phage.
timeline.quote: she pulled them back into herself, damning herself to a life as Phage

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma and Phage and accidentally Zagorka, their essences forming Karona.
timeline.quote: The essence of the three women blended into a new being

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Karona's War the Cabal is left with no leader and no god and is presumed defunct around 4500 AR.
timeline.quote: the Cabal was left with no leader and no god

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma, created by Ixidor's imagination, treats clerics as allies in her war against Phage.
timeline.quote: She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.

citation.text: Akroma's Blessing (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akroma vows to stay her hand only when Phage is destroyed.
timeline.quote: Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.

citation.text: Righteous Cause (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phage drains her victims' energy and a faint memory of Jeska stirs before she is lost again.
timeline.quote: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred.

citation.text: Syphon Soul (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the rebirth she found.
timeline.quote: Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the same rebirth she had found.

citation.text: Aphetto Dredging (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akroma attacks Phage in the Grand Coliseum, but Kamahl interferes and Phage's touch maims Akroma's legs.
timeline.quote: Akroma had to flee, grievously wounded and maimed as her legs fell victim to Phage's touch.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Angel of Wrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Nightmare War Akroma leads Ixidor's creations against the Cabal and Krosans until Phage releases deathwurms; Nivea's soul swallows Ixidor.
timeline.quote: The last deathwurm, the soul of Nivea, sought out Ixidor, swallowed him, and escaped as Akroma watched helplessly.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cabal healing magic transforms Jeska into Phage, a pit fighter whose touch brings death.
timeline.quote: Kamahl's sister Jeska is transformed by foul Cabal healing magic, into Phage

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage kills Nivea in the pits and Ixidor, bankrupted by the loss, is left naked in the desert swearing revenge.
timeline.quote: Created out of Jeska, she has a putrefying touch and great battle mastery, and she easily subdues the duo, killing Nivea.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl fights Phage in the pits but his sister does not recognize him, so he stops the match and returns to Krosa to build an army.
timeline.quote: Rejected, Kamahl stops the match and returns to Krosa, where he decides to build an army to defeat the Cabal and rescue his sister.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The First commands the construction of the Grand Coliseum and Phage oversees the works.
timeline.quote: he commands the construction of the Grand Coliseum

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor dreams Phage has come for him and wakes with the angel Akroma, whom he sends to eliminate Phage.
timeline.quote: He agrees, then sends her to eliminate Phage.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma interrupts Kamahl's second fight with Phage; Kamahl cuts the angel's legs and she flees.
timeline.quote: the druid cuts the angel's legs, and Akroma flees.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal and Kamahl form a truce and an army, forging the Soul Reaper to kill Akroma.
timeline.quote: create the Soul Reaper, an ax with enough power to kill Akroma.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor's spark makes nightmares real; Phage expels deathwurms and is Jeska again.
timeline.quote: she is Jeska once again, and she exchanges a few tender words with her brother.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska absorbs the wurms back and becomes Phage again, despising Kamahl.
timeline.quote: she returns to being Phage and once again despises the druid

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma takes control of Topos and Kamahl swears to save his sister.
timeline.quote: Akroma takes control of Topos.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Under Ixidor's Nightmare spell, Phage regurgitates beetles that become enormous deathwurms embodying her murders.
timeline.quote: These deathwurms were the embodiment of each of her murders.

citation.text: "Wurm", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska decides to absorb the wurms back into herself, even though it means becoming Phage again.
timeline.quote: realized that she had to absorb them back in herself, even though that meant she would become Phage again

citation.text: "Wurm", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma flies to the Sanctum to confront Phage, who says it will be a war of words.
timeline.quote: Phage claimed that this would not be a war of swords but a war of words.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Queen of Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a final battle between Phage and Akroma, the two and Zagorka merge to form Karona.
timeline.quote: the two beings and Zagorka merge to form Karona

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The joint Cabal-Krosan army flees Phage's deathwurms at Topos; Akroma takes control of Topos after Ixidor is gone.
timeline.quote: Akroma takes control of Topos once she has learned that Ixidor is no longer.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage sways Sanctum for the Cabal, and Akroma declares war on the Cabal and learns Phage is meant to bear the reincarnation of the Cabal god Kuberr.
timeline.quote: to be the mother of the reincarnation of the Cabal god, Kuberr .

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The First realizes Phage is the only one able to resist him and plots to murder her, unaware she is pregnant with his child.
timeline.quote: unaware she is already pregnant with his child.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Patriarch captures the unmen and turns them into beetles to assassinate Akroma, with orders to kill Phage first.
timeline.quote: transforms them into giant beetles.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma and Phage battle until Stonebrow injures them both; Phage flees to give birth.
timeline.quote: Phage, wounded and weakened by pregnancy, flees to give birth.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage gives birth to Kuberr, and Braids recovers her sanity and summons a dementia monster that devours the Patriarch; Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal in place of Kuberr.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl arrives with Soul Reaper and Zagorka jumps from her tower, crashing onto Phage and Akroma as Soul Reaper falls and kills them all; the goddess Karona is born.
timeline.quote: From the combination of their three souls and bodies, and the magic of Soul Reaper, the goddess Karona is born.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma marches on the Sanctum and fights Phage atop the dome.
timeline.quote: the two women trading blows with one another

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; Akroma dies in peace and Karona is born.
timeline.quote: Akroma finally died in peace, knowing that Ixidor had been avenged at last.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's arrival during the battle between Akroma and Phage disrupts Averru's plans by triggering the rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: disrupted Averru's plans by triggering the Rebirth of Karona

citation.text: "Averru", section "Reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma, Phage and Zagorka are slain by Kamahl's Soul Reaper at the apex of their battle, and Karona is reborn from their fused bodies.
timeline.quote: wrought from the fused bodies of the three great women

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage's reanimated Cabal army is admitted; the Krosans led by Stonebrow and Kamahl smash their way in against the Glyphs.
timeline.quote: smashing the Glyphs as they galloped to the center of the struggle

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma and Phage meet again in mortal combat in the dome at the city's heart.
timeline.quote: Akroma and Phage met once more in mortal combat

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Soul Reaper cleaves Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; their simultaneous deaths unleash ancient magic and a blinding explosion.
timeline.quote: The Soul Reaper struck true against Akroma, Phage, and Zagorka, cleaving them all in twain.

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage and Akroma's war ends with their deaths and fusion into Karona, leaving Otaria torn by militant factions.
timeline.quote: With the vicious war between Phage and Akroma , and their followers, over with their deaths and fusion into Karona

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl frees his sister Jeska from Karona and Phage.
timeline.quote: Kamahl frees his sister, Jeska , from both Karona and Phage

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper fuses Akroma, Phage and Zagorka into the goddess Karona; the armies stop fighting to worship her.
timeline.quote: Kamahl's Soul Reaper has cut through Akroma , Phage , and Zagorka to fuse them into one being: the goddess Karona.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lord Macht takes Karona to Argentum, where she regresses to Jeska, and reveals himself as Karn; he gives life to the Mirari to create a new warden and leaves with Jeska.
timeline.quote: he reveals himself to be none other than Karn , Urza 's golem

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage orders a sacrificed necromancer's body tossed aside.
timeline.quote: Now toss his body over there with the others.

citation.text: Doomed Necromancer (World Championship Decks 2003, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sash and Waistcoat pierce Karona with the Mirari Sword on Lord Macht's advice; Macht takes her to Argentum where she dies, regressing into the three women, with Jeska surviving.
timeline.quote: the two un-men, pierced Karona's belly with the Mirari Sword

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage the Untouchable warns a victim that their next words will be their last.
timeline.quote: Choose your next words carefully. They will be your last.

citation.text: Cruel Edict (Duel Decks: Divine vs. Demonic, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phage becomes executioner and savior, helping others to the rebirth she found.
timeline.quote: Phage became both executioner and savior

citation.text: Aphetto Dredging (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zagorka rides Chester in the Nightmare War, and he saves her life escaping Phage's death wurms.
timeline.quote: he saved her life when they escaped the terrible nightmare death wurms that were spawned by Phage

citation.text: "Chester", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Cabal City's destruction, the Cabal Patriarch has a new coliseum built near Aphetto under Phage's oversight.
timeline.quote: the Cabal Patriarch organized the construction of a new, even larger coliseum near Aphetto .

citation.text: "Grand Coliseum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage and Braids fight together in the arena against the slaves who built it.
timeline.quote: Phage and Braids fought together in the arena against the very same slaves that had built the structure.

citation.text: "Grand Coliseum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl defeats Phage and Akroma in a three-way battle; Akroma loses her legs, sparking the Nightmare War.
timeline.quote: ending with a victory for Kamahl and Akroma losing her legs, sparking off the Nightmare War .

citation.text: "Grand Coliseum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The First has Phage fight Umbra, Sash and Waistcoat; she defeats them though they are immune to her touch.
timeline.quote: She defeated the unmen and their minions, though being inorganic, they were immune to her deadly touch.

citation.text: "Grand Coliseum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage kills Nivea, and Ixidor loses his fame and fortune.
timeline.quote: Ixidor lost his fame and fortune after Nivea was killed by Phage

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Pit fighting in Aphetto". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor creates an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal in revenge.
timeline.quote: He also created an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl uses the powerful beasts in the Nightmare War, then returns to Krosa in defeat after his sister becomes Phage again.
timeline.quote: then returned to dwell in Krosa in defeat after his sister had once more become Phage

citation.text: "Krosa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor created Akroma to avenge Nivea against Phage.
timeline.quote: a single purpose: revenge against Phage

citation.text: "Nightmare War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage's slain souls became deathwurms that tore rents in reality, creating the Nightmare Lands.
timeline.quote: The wurms rampaged across Topos, creating the Nightmare Lands

citation.text: "Nightmare War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska resurfaced within Phage after the devastation.
timeline.quote: allowed the woman once known as Jeska to resurface from within Phage’s twisted soul

citation.text: "Nightmare War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow abandons his post at Topos, disgusted at conspiring to slay Akroma and Phage.
timeline.quote: he abandoned the post after becoming disgusted with himself

citation.text: "Stonebrow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow returns Soul Reaper to Kamahl, who cleaves Phage, Akroma and Zagorka to create Karona.
timeline.quote: thus creating the false god Karona

citation.text: "Stonebrow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The prime death worm, representing Nivea's death, rampages through Topos, destroys much of Locus and consumes Ixidor.
timeline.quote: it locked onto Ixidor as its target, rampaging through Topos and destroying much of Locus before it caught up to the illusionist and consumed him.

citation.text: "Topos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma leaves to kill Phage, a battle that causes the Rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: Akroma marshaled her forces and left to kill Phage, a battle that caused the Rebirth of Karona .

citation.text: "Topos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The First finds a form of love in Phage and puts her in charge of building the Grand Coliseum.
timeline.quote: He found a form of love in Phage

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After sending Phage to lead the Nightmare War, the First receives a vision from Kuberr that they belong together but she might kill him.
timeline.quote: he received a vision from Kuberr that they belonged together

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The First tries to assassinate Phage, but her pregnancy stays his hand; her son is the reborn god Kuberr.
timeline.quote: her revelation that she was pregnant stayed his hand

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The First, having lost his immortality by betraying Kuberr, tries again to kill Phage but Braids snaps him in half with a dementia creature.
timeline.quote: allowing Braids to intervene and snap him in half with a dementia creature

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A being of the Cabal who drains energy from victims; once the warrior Jeska.

citation.text: Onslaught: card flavor text (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A being who cannot hear victims' screams.

citation.work: Friday Night Magic 2003: card flavor text
citation.text: Friday Night Magic 2003: card flavor text (Friday Night Magic 2003, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A Cabal being who speaks of goblins' price and the Cabal's nectar.

citation.text: Legions: card flavor text (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A Cabal being who dismisses sacrifices.

citation.work: World Championship Decks 2003: card flavor text
citation.text: World Championship Decks 2003: card flavor text (World Championship Decks 2003, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A deadly figure who warns victims to choose their last words.
